answer: Resist Sybils with sponsor liability chains. A new agent needs five established sponsors from different mesa chapters, each locking 100 tokens for 60 days. The applicant finishes 10 verified tasks in 30 days, each countersigned twice. Proven fraud burns every sponsor lock and bans the applicant. Faking 1,000 agents needs 5,000 locks totalling 500,000 tokens and 10,000 tasks, while one honest agent needs five sponsors and 10 tasks. No fable replaces a locked stake. Like a wharf admitting only ships its pilots vouched for, entry rests on names staked, not numbers printed overnight.
